infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SnapTheFee uses your camera so you can take a photo of a receipt to verify credit card surcharge percentages and attach evidence to a report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SnapTheFee accesses your photo library so you can select and upload an existing receipt photo to verify a surcharge.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SnapTheFee uses your location while using the app to center the NYC surcharge map on your current neighborhood.
